title: Keep known daemon runtime-directory failures non-retryable
outcome: Keep known daemon runtime-directory failures non-retryable
acceptance: A known unsafe runtime-directory failure during daemon startup returns a typed non-retryable refusal with no in-session recovery, consistent with endpoint-selection failures; a regression test distinguishes it from the generic unknown proxy failure.

completion.summary: Scoped preparation IO/UnauthorizedAccess failures now produce daemon_runtime_directory_unavailable with retryable:false and no in-session recovery. Real Windows file/link obstructions are test-first reproduced/fixed; generic unknown mapper stays retryable:true. Unix's existing earlier authority refusal is an unexecuted control on this Windows host. Transient IO at this boundary also receives nonretryable advice. Full gates and fresh full-union Codex/Claude reviews CLEAN; new nonblocking findings tracked separately. Implemented and reviewed, not committed/pushed.
